verdict.rationale: GitCafe documents opening pull requests (`cafe stack submit` opens one PR per commit; the CLI manages PRs) and reviewing each change. Its homepage explicitly claims you can 'compare diffs, and leave feedback alongside the code,' and rulesets can require PR reviews. Inline commenting rests on a single marketing line rather than dedicated docs. missing for 10: dedicated documentation of the PR diff view and inline/line-level review comment workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
